caption: IN THE MATTER OF DISBARMENT OF JUSTIN P. NADEAU
text: Justin P. Nadeau, of Rye, New Hampshire, having been suspended from the practice of law in this Court by order of August 18, 2025; and a rule having been issued and served upon him requiring him to show cause why he should not be disbarred; and a response having been filed; It is ordered that Justin P. Nadeau is disbarred from the practice of law in this Court.

label: Attorney discipline
caption: IN THE MATTER OF DISBARMENT OF GARY PISNER
text: Gary Pisner, of Fairfax, Virginia, having been suspended from the practice of law in this Court by order of September 5, 2025; and a rule having been issued and served upon him requiring him to show cause why he should not be disbarred; and a response having been filed; It is ordered that Gary Pisner is disbarred from the practice of law in this Court.
